camel_example: aliyun dts StartDtsJob --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId l3m1213ye7l0000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aek2ilvoxlrdcby' --ZeroEtlJob true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DtsInstanceId dtsl3m1213ye7l0000 --SynchronizationDirection Forward
description_en: Starts a data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task by calling the StartDtsJob operation
description_zh: 调用StartDtsJob接口启动一个迁移、同步或订阅任务
kebab_example: aliyun dts start-dts-job --dts-job-id l3m1213ye7l0000 --dts-instance-id dtsl3m1213ye7l0000 --synchronization-direction Forward --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zero-etl-job true --resource-group-id rg-aek2ilvoxlrdcby --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartDtsJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking instance.
You can query the instance ID by invoking https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208139.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49442.html, or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49454.html
parameters.help_zh:
迁移、同步或订阅实例ID。
可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208139.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49442.html 、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49454.html进行查询
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
Forward: forward. This is the default value.
Reverse: reverse.
You can set this parameter to Reverse to start the reverse synchronization link only when the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
同步方向，取值：
Forward：正向，默认值。
Reverse：反向。
当数据同步实例的拓扑类型为双向时，才可以传入Reverse以启动反向同步链路
parameters.name: synchronization_direction

parameters.help_en: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the node is a zero-ETL node. Valid values:

false: no.
true: yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否无感集成（Zero-ETL）任务，取值：

false：否。
true：是
parameters.name: zero_etl_job
